name: smart-sprint-planner
title: Smart Sprint Planner
description: Multi-role sprint planning plugin for YouTrack 2024.3+. Supports 9 functional roles with separate composition tables, resources, and history snapshots. Plugin settings live in a dedicated widget with server-side authorization.
changeNotes:
Major upgrade since v3.16.0

🧹 Simpler settings & planning — roles and their estimate/actual/assignee fields live in one table; honest hints mark the groups that are truly required; «hours per day» fields are back for Light/Full models; dead and noisy controls are gone (strategy select, duplicate UI-language picker, norms hidden in the Simple model). One «Refresh from issues» button above the role cards instead of a copy per role, «Finish all roles» with outcome/retro prefill in the sprint history, the Backlog section appears only once zones are configured, and the grade on «People» is locked while an approved capacity record exists.

📊 Stand-up by real states — the three summary buckets are replaced by sections for the actual task states: order and chip colors come straight from your State field bundle, every section is a collapsible spoiler, and the new «All roles» mode (default) shows the whole sprint with summed plan/fact hours and assignee lists.

⚙️ Stand-up tuning — map states to roles for focused per-role views (a role's tasks in other states fold into «Other states») and hide noisy states entirely, right from the project settings.

🧮 Sharper multi-role summary — a sortable «Assignee» column, state sorting in your workflow order instead of the alphabet, a «hide tasks excluded from sprint» filter, and accordion headers that count only active tasks — no more false overlimit.

🔌 Integration-friendly composition — REST clients can send just issue IDs: titles, states, priorities and more are filled in server-side from YouTrack, with strict project isolation and visibility checks.

🛡 Security hardening — a full authorization audit shipped across two releases: tightened role gates on history and sprint operations, a field allow-list for issue writes, server-side audit stamps, and a SECURITY access matrix regenerated from code and locked by a test invariant.

⚡ Lighter start-up — the charting library now loads only when you open a report, and Cyrillic is no longer escaped in the bundle: the widget's start-up script payload is 28 % smaller. Same behaviour, same data.

💾 Clear save buttons — the three buttons that all read «Save parameters» are now distinct: «Save role resource» in the role card writes only that role's resource, «Save sprint parameters» in the Sprint inputs card owns name/dates/goal/Sprint/Version, and «Save distribution» on the People tab flushes the per-person distribution. All buttons share one Ring look.

🧠 Preferences that survive a reload — UI language, last active role, table sort order, collapsed rail and other local choices are now stored per user on the server, so they persist across page reloads and browsers — including YouTrack builds where the widget sandbox has no localStorage. The «Share» button hides itself on servers without app deep-link support instead of sitting there disabled.

🧹 Leaner data schema — three long-dead service keys (history-edit flags, the v5.3 migration marker, the pre-role items store) are removed from the schema after a two-release deprecation ladder; stored data is cleaned on first read, nothing to do on your side.

🎨 Native icons instead of emoji — warnings, sprint goal, goal outcome, working-copy markers and release previews now use the YouTrack icon set (crisp in both themes, identical on every OS); the composition tree of a release follows the parent ← child link configured for cascade aggregation (Subtask by default — unchanged for most teams); leftover untranslated labels in 13 locales are translated; bordered buttons keep an inner padding so a long label never touches the border in any locale.

🐛 Reliability fixes — assignee picks no longer write into live issues while «Quick edit» is off; destructive history clearing requires explicit group membership; saving sprint parameters can no longer rename a different sprint after a picker switch.

🔍 Compatibility — YouTrack 2024.3+. Drop-in upgrade — one new per-user extension property; the only schema migration is automatic and read-time (legacy keys are cleaned when a sprint is first opened).

widgets.name: Smart Sprint Planner
widgets.description: Planner settings for the project: functional roles and issue fields, permission groups (validation / editing / assignee assignment / history clearing), planning modes. Sprint planning itself lives in the main-menu item «Smart Sprint Planner».

widgets.name: Smart Sprint Planner
widgets.description: Sprint planning from YouTrack's main menu: pick an accessible project where the planner is set up, plan sprint composition by role, allocate tasks, review history. Permissions and settings are checked against the selected project. Includes a «Backlog» module for triaging and laying pool tasks into roles/sprint.
